title: Applications Of Robotics
definition: The deployment of programmable, autonomous, or semi-autonomous mechanical systems integrated with artificial intelligence, sensors, and actuators to perform complex physical tasks across industrial, medical, agricultural, and security domains.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE GS Paper 3 (Science & Technology - Awareness in the fields of IT, Space, Computers, Robotics, Nanotechnology, Bio-technology) and ethical dimensions in GS Paper 4.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Applications Of Robotics.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
